themes.name: AI compute: NVIDIA's supply chain
themes.what: Bloomberg reported Nov 27 that Nvidia Blackwell hardware, which needs a US license for China, appears in loan filings for a Shanghai data center linked to Megaspeed's founder; Bloomberg said it has no evidence Megaspeed diverted the chips, and Nvidia did not respond (Bloomberg via mlq.ai). Jensen Huang sits for a closed door House interview Dec 1 and testifies in public to Senate Banking on Dec 3 at 10am ET on export controls (Senate Banking; The Hill). NVDA rose 19.9% for the week to 150.49 but only 0.8% Friday (Massive).
themes.for_you: No chip entries before the Dec 3 hearing: a hearing on chips reaching China can move NVDA 5% to 10% in a day. NVDA is still under its falling 200 day (202.62) with no buy point, and no puts on it.

countries.name: Gulf (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Iran risk)
countries.what: Brent settled 1.2% lower at $95.44 on Nov 27 but rose about 3% for the week, its first weekly gain in November (Reuters via mlq.ai). Three sources told Reuters OPEC+ has agreed in principle to hold first quarter 2027 output targets at Sunday's Nov 29 meeting; Iraq said it is negotiating for a higher ceiling.
countries.for_you: A rollover is mostly priced in, so the bigger risk Monday is Iran headlines, not OPEC. Oil names lagged the S&P 500 Friday and DAL beat it, so oil is not driving these stocks day to day right now. DAL closed 84.82, near the top of its long term zone (85.19): no chase. No energy setups.
